title: Pan-Seared Squid with Asian Flair
description: A delicious and easy-to-make squid dish with a Chinese twist, featuring a flavorful marinade and a crispy sear.
instructions: 1. Rinse the squid and pat it dry with paper towels.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the exotic oil, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic to make the marinade.
3. Add the squid to the marinade and coat it evenly.
4. Let the squid marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
5. Preheat a skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
6. Remove the squid from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
7. Add the squid to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until it's golden brown and cooked through.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Serve the squid hot and enjoy!
10. Garnish with chopped scallions or sesame seeds, if desired.
